faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about women's health, pregnancy care, and gynecological treatments.

questions.question: When should I visit a gynecologist?
questions.answer: You should visit a gynecologist for regular checkups, menstrual issues, pregnancy planning, unusual pain, infections, or any concerns related to women’s health.

questions.question: What services does Dr. Kusum Lata provide?
questions.answer: Dr. Kusum Lata offers comprehensive care including pregnancy care, infertility treatment, cosmetic gynecology, laparoscopic surgery, menstrual disorder treatment, and preventive women’s healthcare.

questions.question: Is laparoscopic surgery safe?
questions.answer: Yes, laparoscopic surgery is a minimally invasive and safe procedure with faster recovery, less pain, and minimal scarring when performed by an experienced specialist.

questions.question: How often should I go for a gynecological checkup?
questions.answer: It is recommended to visit a gynecologist at least once a year for routine checkups, or more frequently if you have ongoing health concerns.

questions.question: What should I expect during my first visit?
questions.answer: During your first visit, the doctor will review your medical history, discuss your concerns, and may perform a basic examination if required to provide proper guidance and treatment.

questions.question: Do you provide pregnancy and prenatal care?
questions.answer: Yes, complete pregnancy care including prenatal checkups, ultrasound guidance, nutrition advice, and delivery planning is provided.

questions.question: Is consultation confidential?
questions.answer: Yes, all consultations and treatments are completely confidential, ensuring your privacy and comfort at every step.

surgery.name: Endometriosis Surgery
surgery.description: Advanced laparoscopic surgery to remove endometriosis tissue, reduce chronic pelvic pain, preserve fertility, and improve quality of life.

surgery.name: Fibroid Removal
surgery.description: Minimally invasive removal of uterine fibroids while preserving the uterus, ideal for women planning future pregnancies.

surgery.name: Ovarian Cyst Removal
surgery.description: Laparoscopic ovarian cyst removal with fertility-preserving techniques to relieve pain, prevent complications, and protect ovarian function.

surgery.name: Uterus Removal
surgery.description: Minimally invasive hysterectomy performed for large fibroids, abnormal bleeding, adenomyosis, or other uterine conditions when necessary.

surgery.name: Fertility Enhancing Surgery
surgery.description: Specialized laparoscopic and hysteroscopic procedures designed to improve fertility by treating endometriosis, fibroids, adhesions, and tubal problems.

surgery.name: Hysteroscopy
surgery.description: Advanced day-care procedure used to diagnose and treat uterine polyps, fibroids, adhesions, abnormal bleeding, infertility, and recurrent miscarriages.

surgery.name: Cancer Surgery
surgery.description: Comprehensive surgical treatment for gynecological cancers including uterine, ovarian, and cervical cancers using advanced minimally invasive techniques whenever possible.

surgery.name: Cervical Cerclage
surgery.description: Laparoscopic cervical cerclage provides strong cervical support to help prevent recurrent miscarriages, preterm birth, and pregnancy loss due to cervical weakness.
